claims.text: LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to its simpler design that better accommodates the characteristics of this type of data.
SOTA methods like CGExpan are penalized by their design choices, which do not generalize well to the multifaceted and vague entities present in user-generated text.
The performance of SOTA methods drops significantly on user-generated text benchmarks compared to simpler baselines like LM-Base.
